title: The contraherent version of the theorem of Slavik and Stovicek
summary: This is a paper about contraherent cosheaves on non-semi-separated schemes. We prove two theorems, a negative one and a positive one. On the negative side, let $X$ be a quasi-compact, quasi-separated scheme that is not semi-separated. We present a locally cotorsion contraherent cosheaf on $X$ that does not have an admissible monomorphism into any locally injective locally contraherent cosheaf. The construction and proof follow the arguments of Slavik and Stovicek in arXiv:1902.05740. On the positive side, let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme of finite Krull dimension.
